notices.text: Coordinates: the file's own x/y_trans and x/y/z_local; the motions (P₀ subtracted, then R(θ, φ) applied) were also applied to every cell here, and the two differ by at most 3.82e−05 mm (within the 0.01 mm tolerance).

One half-width for every panel of this event: the widest energy-weighted 0.1st–99.9th percentile range of its cells over x, y, z and u, v, w (u and v about the shower's own axis), plus one cell footprint so the cells at either end are drawn whole, never below 150 mm and snapped outward to 20 mm (700 mm here); lattice panels snap it outward to whole cells, grid panels to whole bins; depth is cropped to the event, which the ensemble frames never do. All 170 cells lie inside it in every frame.

One logarithmic ramp for every panel of this event: projected energy surface density in GeV per mm², from the 1st percentile of this shower's positive lattice-cell densities (6.05e−13) to its brightest bin (1.36e−05); 66 bins below the floor are drawn at the lowest colour.
